description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to appoint Mr. R. H. T. S. Hettiarachchi, G. K. G. T. D. Gedarakumbura, T. H. B. A. Deshapriya & W. K. Liyanage to the President's Staff as an Assistant Secretary to the President, w.e.f. 23.01.2017
categorisation: The gazette content contains multiple appointments of named individuals (Mr. R. H. T. S. Hettiarachchi, Mrs. G. K. G. T. D. Gedarakumbura, Mr. T. H. B. A. Deshapriya, Mr. W. K. Liyanage) to the position of Assistant Secretary to the President. It only mentions their basic titles and does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas they will oversee. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio information.
